verdict.rationale: Insomnia's Design feature offers a generated spec preview, automatic linting, and code-snippet generation in 12+ languages, and the core client lets users send/run real HTTP, GraphQL, gRPC and WebSocket requests against collections with live responses — functioning as an interactive, runnable way to explore an API. However, there is no evidence of a hosted, browsable 'API reference' page (e.g., a Swagger/Readme-style try-it-out reference) specifically for AI-native consumption, nor documentation of an OpenAPI/reference endpoint (the probe for openapi.json/swagger.json returned 404s). Missing for 10: a first-party interactive API reference page/portal with embedded runnable examples, and independent confirmation that AI-native users can browse/execute such a reference outside the desktop client.
